body:
1\. Uppercase templates bypass autoescape 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
Removing filename.lower() makes select_jinja_autoescape return false for uppercase or mixed-case
extensions such as page.HTML and icon.SVG. Because this function supplies Jinja's default
autoescape policy, untrusted values rendered by those templates are emitted without HTML escaping,
creating an XSS regression.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Restore case-insensitive matching in `select_jinja_autoescape` so uppercase and mixed-case HTML, XML, XHTML, and SVG template extensions continue to enable Jinja autoescaping. ## Issue Context The prior implementation normalized the filename before checking its extension. The new case-sensitive check changes public behavior and can disable escaping for templates such as `page.HTML`. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/sansio/app.py[542-544] - tests/test_templating.py[1-1] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
